notes: «قالا حدثنا ح» gives the pair no named shaykh before the taḥwīl: the first branch is the pair only
The shared tail begins at شعبة, which the text writes once after «قالا» and the last «ح»
«قال أبو الوليد قال سمعت عطاء الكيخاراني» and «قال أبو داود» are remarks, not routes; Abu al-Walid's kunya is not identified
